title: The OverrideBuiltins should be avoided on privileged JavaScript environment
body:
The `[OverrideBuiltins]` attribute can cause some tricky/horrible results including `<form>.parentElement === <input>`, which means a risk of crashes and attacks for "privileged" JavaScript environment. As a result, Firefox has used "`Xray vision`" to avoid it, and Chrome has "`isolated`" (JavaScript) worlds compared to its "`MainWorld`".

However, there's an important difference between the two technologies: Firefox's Xray wrapper refused the `[OverrideBuiltins]` attribute on named property getters on some classes like `<form>`, but Chrome does not refuse it. As a result, if a Chrome extension want to visit `<form>.parentElement`, it has to re-check whether the result is correct (or just a `<input name="parentElement">`).

In my opinion, an `[OverrideBuiltins]` named property getter is indeed: harmful for security personnel and annoying for framework / webextension developer - it's like a hidden bomb!
Therefore I expect that the specification can **declare that `[OverrideBuiltins]` should only take effects on less-privileged content scripts** (in v8, it's the main world).

### related:

* here's a simple demo page to show how annoying a named property getter can be:
  * https://jsfiddle.net/bvumn4g3/
* some issues on whatwg related to my worry: #1562 and #2212
* some discussion about the importance of "Xray vision":
  * named getters and Xray: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=987794
  * `<iframe name="top">` may cause errors: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=860494
* I've filed a Chromium bug, but got an answer of "WontFix" "unless some spec define so"
  * it's https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=897399
  * but since webextensions on Firefox don't need to worry this issue at all, I think this issue is valued
* here's some documents I find, about Firefox's `Xray vision`:
  * https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Tech/Xray_vision
  * http://devdoc.net/web/developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Add-ons/WebExtensions/Content_scripts.html#DOM_access
  * the specific code to disable "[OverrideBuiltins]" on Xray wrappers is https://dxr.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/source/dom/bindings/Codegen.py#11709
